activity_summary: About noon a neighbour's journeyman came to the street door with an account of the morning. You did not go down. You sent Alse to say you were at your work. You were not. The account did not come up the stair.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the door, and was not at his work.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Carried the sentence down and shut the door.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tell him I am at my work.
